title: OFSCP WS dm.reaction event (v0.1)
description: Emitted to a DM conversation's subscribers when a reaction is added to or removed from a DM message stored in the recipient's inbox (§7.4). DM-scoped mirror of reaction.added/reaction.removed: `state` is `added` (carries the full `reaction`) or `removed` (carries `key`+`author`).

reaction.description: Present on state=added; the full Reaction object.

key.description: Present on state=removed; the reaction key that was removed.

author.description: Present on state=removed; the actor whose reaction was removed.
